title: Reinspection Reserve Held From Overpayment Refunds — Insurance Claim Repairs Credit Control
content:
**Memo clause.** A supplement on an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order is undecided while the latest submitted supplement number is above the latest decided one (with no decided supplement, the latest decided number is taken as zero). While a supplement is undecided a reinspection reserve is held from an overpayment refund: the field reserve of **USD 50.00** when the undecided supplement is on field reinspection, the desk reserve of **USD 25.00** when it is on desk review, and nothing when no supplement is undecided.

The amount held is taken off the excess on the repair order before the refund is limited to the payment it returns; the refund never falls below zero.

## Reserve table

| Latest submitted supplement number compared with latest decided | Route of the undecided supplement | Reserve held |
|---|---|---|
| above | field reinspection | USD 50.00 |
| above | desk review | USD 25.00 |
| equal (every submitted supplement decided) | — | none |

## Hypothetical supplement histories

- Supplements 1 and 2 submitted, supplement 1 decided, supplement 2 on desk review: 2 is above 1 — USD 25.00 held.
- Supplements 1, 2 and 3 submitted, supplement 3 on field reinspection, supplements 1 and 2 decided: USD 50.00 held.
- Supplement 1 submitted and on field reinspection, nothing decided yet: 1 is above zero — USD 50.00 held.
- Supplements 1 and 2 submitted and both decided: nothing undecided — no reserve.
